";
function recordedEngine(pcm){
  const bytes=atob(pcm);
  const buffer=audioContext.createBuffer(1,bytes.length/2,24000);
  const samples=buffer.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<samples.length;i++){
    const value=bytes.charCodeAt(i*2)|(bytes.charCodeAt(i*2+1)<<8);
    samples[i]=(value>=32768?value-65536:value)/32768;
  }
  return buffer;
}
function engineLayer(buffer,loop,level,output,startAt){
  const source=audioContext.createBufferSource();
  source.buffer=buffer;source.loop=loop;source.connect(level);level.connect(output);
  source.start(startAt);
  return source;
}
function mediaState() {
  el("track").textContent=tracks[trackIndex]?.name ?? "الأنشودة "+(trackIndex+1);
  el("play").textContent=audio.paused?"▶":"⏸";
  el("play").setAttribute("aria-label",audio.paused?"تشغيل":"إيقاف مؤقت");
  el("play").disabled=tripPrayerActive;
}
function selectTrack(index, play) {
  trackIndex=(index+tracks.length)%tracks.length;
  const item=tracks[trackIndex];
  if(!item){audio.pause();audio.removeAttribute("src");audio.load();mediaState();return;}
  if(audio.getAttribute("src")!==item.url) audio.src=item.url;
  if(play){
    if(tripPrayerActive)resumeNasheed=true;
    else audio.play().catch(()=>mediaState());
  }
  mediaState();
}
function skipTrack(direction){
  for(let step=1;step<tracks.length;step++){
    const next=(trackIndex+direction*step+tracks.length)%tracks.length;
    if(tracks[next]){selectTrack(next,!audio.paused);return;}
  }
}
function startAudio() {
  const Context=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
  if(!Context) return;
  if(!audioContext){
    audioContext=new Context();
    sfx=audioContext.createGain();sfx.connect(audioContext.destination);
    const now=audioContext.currentTime;
    engineMaster=audioContext.createGain();
    const clarity=audioContext.createBiquadFilter();clarity.type="peaking";clarity.frequency.value=740;clarity.Q.value=.8;clarity.gain.value=3.5;
    const limiter=audioContext.createDynamicsCompressor();limiter.threshold.value=-9;limiter.ratio.value=3;
    engineMaster.gain.value=1.65;engineMaster.connect(clarity);clarity.connect(limiter);limiter.connect(sfx);
    const starter=audioContext.createGain();starter.gain.value=1.07;
    idleLevel=audioContext.createGain();idleLevel.gain.value=0;
    revLevel=audioContext.createGain();revLevel.gain.value=0;
    revFilter=audioContext.createBiquadFilter();revFilter.type="lowpass";revFilter.frequency.value=380;
    revFilter.connect(engineMaster);
    const idle=recordedEngine(idlePCM), ignitionClip=recordedEngine(starterPCM);
    startupUntil=now+ignitionClip.duration;
    engineLayer(ignitionClip,false,starter,engineMaster,now);
    engineLayer(idle,true,idleLevel,engineMaster,startupUntil);
    revSource=engineLayer(idle,true,revLevel,revFilter,startupUntil);
    engineBass=audioContext.createOscillator();engineBass.type="triangle";engineBass.frequency.value=39;
    bassLevel=audioContext.createGain();bassLevel.gain.value=0;
    engineBass.connect(bassLevel);bassLevel.connect(revFilter);engineBass.start(now);
    const buffer=audioContext.createBuffer(1,audioContext.sampleRate*2,audioContext.sampleRate);
    const samples=buffer.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<samples.length;i++)samples[i]=Math.random()*2-1;
    const noise=audioContext.createBufferSource();noise.buffer=buffer;noise.loop=true;
    windFilter=audioContext.createBiquadFilter();windFilter.type="lowpass";windFilter.frequency.value=250;
    roadNoise=audioContext.createGain();roadNoise.gain.value=0;
    noise.connect(windFilter);windFilter.connect(roadNoise);roadNoise.connect(sfx);noise.start();
  }
  audioContext.resume().catch(()=>{});
  sfx.gain.value=Number(el("volume").value);
}
const dieselShiftSpeeds=[19,35,58,87,125,181,410];
function mixEngine(throttle,brake){
  if(!audioContext)return;
  const now=audioContext.currentTime,speed=game.speed,mps=speed/3.6;
  if(now<startupUntil)return;
  const gear=dieselShiftSpeeds.findIndex(max=>speed<max);
  const base=gear===0?0:dieselShiftSpeeds[gear-1];
  const rpm=clamp((speed-base)/(dieselShiftSpeeds[gear]-base),0,1);
  const standing=speed<1&&!throttle&&!game.active;
  const load=standing?0:game.active?1:throttle?(speed<2?.68:.9):brake?.16:speed>2?.23:0;
  const rev=clamp(.16+rpm*.7+load*.27,0,1);
  engineMaster.gain.setTargetAtTime(game.pedestrian?Math.max(.13,1.65/(1+distanceFromDoor()*.18)):game.exterior?1.7:1.55,now,.15);
  idleLevel.gain.setTargetAtTime(.56-load*.32,now,.24);
  revSource.playbackRate.setTargetAtTime(1.02+rev*1.28,now,.125);
  revFilter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(320+rev*1040+load*560,now,.18);
  revLevel.gain.setTargetAtTime(load*.57+(speed>2?.078:0),now,load>.5?.10:.25);
  engineBass.frequency.setTargetAtTime(32+rev*55,now,.14);
  bassLevel.gain.setTargetAtTime(load*.075,now,.16);
  roadNoise.gain.setTargetAtTime(Math.min(.105,mps*.0018),now,.31);
  windFilter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(115+Math.min(mps,110)*11,now,.24);
}
function sound(frequency,length,volume,kind="triangle",to=frequency) {
  if(!audioContext) return;
  const now=audioContext.currentTime;
  const osc=audioContext.createOscillator(),gain=audioContext.createGain();
  osc.type=kind;osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency,now);osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(to,now+length);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.001,now);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume,now+.035);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+length);
  osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(sfx);osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+length+.02);
}
function horn(){sound(227,.43,.1,"sawtooth");sound(179,.43,.09,"triangle");}
function stationAt(km,range=12) {return stations.find(station=>Math.abs(station.km-km)*WORLD<=range);}
function canRefuel(state) {
  return Boolean(stationAt(state.km,16)&&state.speed<1&&state.lateral>=19&&state.lateral<=31&&
    (!state.pedestrian||distanceFromDoor()<10));
}
function doorPosition() {
  const z=game.km*WORLD, x=roadCenter(z)+game.lateral, yaw=roadYawAt(z)+game.yaw;
  return [x+2.7*Math.cos(yaw)+3.7*Math.sin(yaw),z+3.7*Math.cos(yaw)-2.7*Math.sin(yaw),yaw];
}
function distanceFromDoor() {
  const [x,z]=doorPosition();
  return Math.hypot(game.pedestrian.x-x,game.pedestrian.z-z);
}
function toggleWalk() {
  if(!game.started||game.speed>=1)return;
  if(game.pedestrian){
    if(distanceFromDoor()>8)return;
    game.pedestrian=null;document.body.classList.remove("walking");
  }else{
    const [x,z,yaw]=doorPosition();
    game.speed=0;game.active=0;game.gear="P";game.slip=0;game.yawRate=0;
    game.pedestrian={x,z,yaw,pitch:0,steps:0};document.body.classList.add("walking");
  }
  clearKeys();hud();
}
function walk(dt) {
  const person=game.pedestrian;
  const turn=clamp(Number(keys.has("right"))-Number(keys.has("left"))+
    Number(keys.has("lookRight"))-Number(keys.has("lookLeft"))+walkLook.x,-1,1);
  person.yaw+=turn*2.12*dt;
  person.pitch=clamp(person.pitch+walkLook.y*1.25*dt,-.68,.68);
  const forward=clamp(Number(keys.has("up"))-Number(keys.has("down"))-walkMove.y,-1,1);
  const norm=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(forward,walkMove.x));
  const pace=forward*4.2*dt/norm, side=walkMove.x*4.2*dt/norm;
  const busZ=game.km*WORLD,busX=roadCenter(busZ)+game.lateral;
  const x=clamp(person.x+Math.sin(person.yaw)*pace+Math.cos(person.yaw)*side,busX-58,busX+58);
  const z=clamp(person.z+Math.cos(person.yaw)*pace-Math.sin(person.yaw)*side,busZ-64,busZ+64);
  const heading=roadYawAt(busZ)+game.yaw, dx=x-busX,dz=z-busZ;
  const localX=dx*Math.cos(heading)-dz*Math.sin(heading);
  const localZ=dx*Math.sin(heading)+dz*Math.cos(heading);
  if(Math.abs(localX)<1.55&&Math.abs(localZ)<6.8)return;
  person.steps+=Math.hypot(x-person.x,z-person.z);person.x=x;person.z=z;
}
function moveTraffic(dt) {
  const z=game.km*WORLD;
  if(!drifter.seen&&game.km>=TAIF/2){
    drifter.seen=true;drifter.active=true;drifter.z=z+43;
  }
  for(let i=0;i<traffic.length;i++){
    const car=traffic[i];
    if(car.disabledUntil){
      if(game.elapsed<car.disabledUntil)continue;
      car.disabledUntil=0;car.z=z+210+i*15;
    }
    if(car===drifter){
      if(car.active){
        car.z+=dt*car.v*1.64;
        if(car.z<z-36||car.z>z+310)car.active=false;
      }
      continue;
    }
    car.z+=dt*car.v*1.64;
    if(car.z<z-42)car.z=z+140+i*19;
    if(car.z>z+440)car.z=z+80+i*13;
  }
  while(driftSmoke.length&&game.elapsed-driftSmoke[0].time>=2.45)driftSmoke.shift();
  while(blasts.length&&game.elapsed-blasts[0].time>=1.65)blasts.shift();
  emitDriftSmoke();
}
let towService=null;
function requestTow(){
  if(!game.started||game.ended||game.pedestrian||game.fuel>0||game.speed>=1||towService||canRefuel(game))return;
  const next=stations.find(station=>station.km>=game.km);
  towService={km:game.km,age:0,filled:false,destination:next?.name??"الطائف",targetKm:next?.km??TAIF};
  hud();
}
function updateTow(dt){
  if(!towService)return;
  towService.age+=dt;
  if(towService.age>=5.5&&!towService.filled){
    const needed=Math.max(.7,towService.targetKm-game.km+.7);
    game.fuelRange=Math.max(game.fuelRange,needed);
    game.fuel=100*needed/game.fuelRange;
    towService.filled=true;sound(560,.24,.08,"sine",740);
  }
  if(towService.age>=9)towService=null;
}
function drawTowTruck(){
  const age=towService.age, approaching=1-clamp(age/3.8,0,1);
  const departing=Math.max(0,age-6.3);
  const z=towService.km*WORLD+10+81*approaching*approaching-12*departing*departing;
  const y=roadHeight(z),x=roadCenter(z)+7.4;
  const start=data.length;
  box(x,y+.54,z,2.35,.3,6.3,"#383b42");
  box(x,y+.79,z+.76,2.4,.16,4.3,"#a5a0a0");
  box(x,y+.68,z-1.84,2.23,1.91,2,"#d2a225");
  box(x,y+1.69,z-2.873,1.87,.57,.042,"#475966");
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    for(const axle of [-1.92,1.70])wheel(x+side*1.04,y+.46,z+axle,.45,false,z/.45);
    box(x+side*.81,y+.86,z-2.9,.35,.15,.05,"#fff2d7");
  }
  box(x,y+2.59,z-1.86,.88,.124,.24,Math.floor(age*9)%2?"#ffce8c":"#815033");
  orientModel(start,x,z,roadYawAt(z));
  labels.push({x,y:y+3.45,z,text:"سطحة المساعدة",size:19});
}
function activate() {
  if(!game.started||!game.engineOn||game.fuel<=0||game.gear!=="D"||game.active||game.ended||game.elapsed<game.nitroReadyAt)return;
  game.active=8;game.nitroReadyAt=game.elapsed+20;
  sound(85,.62,.10,"triangle",245);hud();
}
function selectGear(gear) {
  if(game.ended||gear===game.gear)return;
  if(game.speed>=1&&gear!=="N"&&!(gear==="D"&&game.direction===1))return;
  game.gear=gear;
  if(gear==="P"||gear==="R")game.speed=0;
  if(gear==="D"||gear==="R")game.direction=gear==="R"?-1:1;
  if(gear!=="D")game.active=0;
  hud();
}
function trafficContact(z,lateral,nextZ,nextLateral,dt) {
  let closest=null;
  for(const car of traffic){
    if(car.disabledUntil)continue;
    if(car===drifter&&!drifter.active)continue;
    const start=car.z-z;
    const nitroAhead=game.active&&start>=0&&nextZ>z;
    const clearance=nitroAhead?21:car.car.d/2+(car===drifter?1.8:2.5);
    const end=start+(car.v*1.64*dt)-(nextZ-z);
    if(Math.min(start,end)>clearance||Math.max(start,end)<-clearance)continue;
    const at=Math.abs(start)<=clearance?1:clamp((start-Math.sign(start)*clearance)/(start-end),0,1);
    const lane=lateral+(nextLateral-lateral)*at;
    const sideGap=nitroAhead?2.75:car===drifter?1.36:1.24+car.car.w/2;
    if(Math.abs(lane-trafficLane(car,game.elapsed-dt*(1-at)))>=sideGap)continue;
    if(!closest||at<closest.at)closest={car,at,start,clearance,sideGap};
  }
  return closest;
}
function update(dt) {
  updateTow(dt);
  if(game.pedestrian){game.elapsed+=dt;walk(dt);moveTraffic(dt);mixEngine(false,false);return;}
  if(!game.started||game.ended)return;
  const oldSpeed=game.speed;
  const z=game.km*WORLD;
  const throttle=throttleReady()&&keys.has("up");
  if(throttle)playTripPrayer();
  const brake=keys.has("down");
  const steering=clamp(Number(keys.has("right"))-Number(keys.has("left"))+wheelInput,-1,1);
  const glance=Number(keys.has("lookRight"))-Number(keys.has("lookLeft"));
  game.elapsed+=dt;
  game.shake=Math.max(0,game.shake-dt);
  game.steer+=(steering-game.steer)*Math.min(1,dt*5.4);
  game.look+=(glance*.24-game.look)*Math.min(1,dt*5);
  if(game.active>0){
    game.active=Math.max(0,game.active-dt);
    if(brake)game.active=0;
  }
  const target=!game.engineOn||game.gear==="P"||(game.fuel===0&&oldSpeed<1)?0:game.active?400:game.direction<0?25:180;
  const grade=(roadHeight(z+5)-roadHeight(z-5))/10;
  const acceleration=brake?-42:game.active?138:throttle?Math.max(4,21-game.speed*.094)-grade*20:-2.4-game.speed*.018-grade*20;
  game.speed=clamp(game.speed+acceleration*dt,0,target);
  if(!game.specialPlayed&&oldSpeed<160&&game.speed>=160){
    game.specialPlayed=true;
    const special=Number(el("special").value);
    if(tracks[special]) selectTrack(special,true);
  }
  if(brake&&oldSpeed>30&&!game.stopSound) {sound(177,.31,.035,"sawtooth",67);game.stopSound=true;}
  if(!brake)game.stopSound=false;
  if(oldSpeed>1&&game.speed===0) sound(51,.26,.05,"sine",26);
  const mps=game.speed/3.6;
  const nearby=stationAt(game.km,74), maneuvering=nearby&&game.speed<38;
  const steerAngle=game.steer*((maneuvering?.74:.49)/(1+mps*.077)+.035);
  game.frontSteer=steerAngle;
  const desiredYawRate=game.direction*mps*Math.tan(steerAngle)/6.5;
  game.yawRate+=(desiredYawRate-game.yawRate)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*9));
  const centering=(maneuvering?1.25:2.35)+Math.max(0,mps-19)*.032;
  const yawLimit=maneuvering?.62:.46;
  game.yaw=clamp((game.yaw+game.yawRate*dt)*Math.exp(-dt*centering),-yawLimit,yawLimit);
  const lateralTarget=Math.sin(game.yaw)*mps*game.direction;
  game.slip+=(lateralTarget-game.slip)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*10));
  game.chaseYaw+=(game.yaw-game.chaseYaw)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*4.8));
  game.roll+=(-clamp(mps*game.yawRate*.009,-.064,.064)-game.roll)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*4.3));
  const pitchTarget=-grade*1.18+clamp(-acceleration*.00135,-.018,.029)+Math.sin(z*1.56)*Math.min(.0027,mps*.000081);
  game.pitch+=(pitchTarget-game.pitch)*Math.min(1,dt*5.5);
  if(game.speed>=.5){
    const access=nearby?clamp((74-Math.abs(nearby.km*WORLD-z))/20,0,1):0;
    const lateral=clamp(game.lateral+game.slip*dt,-5.65,5.65+34*access);
    // The physical scenery is compressed while route distances are expressed in km.
    let traveled=game.direction*game.speed*dt*7/3600;
    const impact=trafficContact(z,game.lateral,z+traveled*WORLD,lateral,dt);
    if(impact&&game.active&&traveled>0&&impact.start>=0){
      blastCar(impact.car);game.lateral=lateral;
    }else if(impact){
      const {car,start,clearance,sideGap}=impact;
      const trafficSpeed=car.v*1.64*3600/(WORLD*7);
      if(game.contact!==car){
        game.shake=.24;game.active=0;
        game.speed=Math.min(game.speed*.60,trafficSpeed*.82,180);
        sound(84,.15,.075,"triangle",38);
      }
      game.contact=car;
      if(start>=0&&traveled>0){
        traveled=Math.min(traveled,Math.max(0,start-clearance+car.v*1.64*dt)/WORLD);
        game.speed=Math.min(game.speed,trafficSpeed);
      }else if(start<0&&traveled<0){
        traveled=0;
        game.speed=0;
      }
      if(Math.abs(game.lateral-trafficLane(car))>=sideGap) {
        game.yaw*=.35;game.slip*=.3;
      } else game.lateral=lateral;
    } else{
      game.contact=null;
      game.lateral=lateral;
    }
    const lastKm=game.km;
    game.km=clamp(game.km+traveled,0,TAIF);
    game.wheelRoll=(game.wheelRoll-(game.km-lastKm)*WORLD/.53)%(2*Math.PI);
    if(game.km===0&&traveled<0)game.speed=0;
    game.fuel=Math.max(0,game.fuel-Math.abs(traveled)*100/game.fuelRange);
    if(game.fuel===0)game.active=0;
    if(game.km===TAIF){game.ended=true;game.speed=0;game.active=0;}
  }
  moveTraffic(dt);
  mixEngine(throttle,brake);
}
function refuel() {
  if(!canRefuel(game))return;
  const station=stationAt(game.km,16);
  const next=stations[stations.indexOf(station)+2];
  game.fuelRange=(next?.km??TAIF)-station.km+.5;
  game.fuel=100;game.refueled.add(station.name);sound(560,.2,.05,"sine",740);hud();
}
const routePoints=[[3,18],[18,13],[31,17],[42,5],[57,6]];
const mapCanvas=el("miniMap"), mapContext=mapCanvas.getContext("2d");
function drawMap() {
  const person=game.pedestrian;
  const size=190, ctx=mapContext, z=person?.z??game.km*WORLD, center=roadCenter(z);
  const project=p=>[95+(roadCenter(p)-center)*1.12,125-(p-z)*.57];
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,size,size);ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(95,95,95,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.clip();
  ctx.fillStyle="#15141e";ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
  ctx.strokeStyle="#ffffff12";ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=23;i<size;i+=24){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i,0);ctx.lineTo(i,size);ctx.moveTo(0,i);ctx.lineTo(size,i);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.beginPath();
  for(let offset=-128;offset<=250;offset+=5){
    const [x,y]=project(z+offset);
    if(offset===-128)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineWidth=15;ctx.strokeStyle="#343140";ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.strokeStyle="#bb86fe";ctx.stroke();
  for(const station of stations){
    if(Math.abs(station.km*WORLD-z)>250)continue;
    const [x,y]=project(station.km*WORLD);
    ctx.fillStyle="#f1bb77";ctx.fillRect(x+9,y-5,9,9);
  }
  ctx.translate(95+(person?person.x-center:game.lateral)*1.12,125);ctx.rotate(person?.yaw??roadYawAt(z)+game.yaw);
  ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-13);ctx.lineTo(8,8);ctx.lineTo(0,4);ctx.lineTo(-8,8);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function hud() {
  if(!game.started)return;
  el("speed").textContent=Math.round(game.speed);
  el("fuelText").textContent="الوقود "+Math.ceil(game.fuel)+"٪";
  el("fuelGauge").value=game.fuel;
  el("fuel").classList.toggle("low",game.fuel<=20);
  el("mecca").textContent=game.km>=MECCA?"تم تجاوز مكة":"مكة "+Math.ceil(MECCA-game.km)+" كم";
  el("taif").textContent="الطائف "+Math.ceil(TAIF-game.km)+" كم";
  el("mapDistance").textContent=Math.ceil(TAIF-game.km)+" كم";
  drawMap();
  for(const button of gearButtons){
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(button.dataset.gear===game.gear));
    button.disabled=game.ended||(game.speed>=1&&!["N",game.gear,game.direction===1?"D":"R"].includes(button.dataset.gear));
  }
  const next=stations.find(station=>station.km*WORLD>=game.km*WORLD-12);
  el("station").textContent=next?next.name+" "+Math.max(0,Math.ceil(next.km-game.km))+" كم":"الطائف";
  const t=game.km/TAIF*4;
  const segment=Math.min(3,Math.floor(t)), a=routePoints[segment], b=routePoints[segment+1];
  el("routeDot").setAttribute("cx",a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*(t-segment));
  el("routeDot").setAttribute("cy",a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*(t-segment));
  const recharge=Math.ceil(Math.max(0,game.nitroReadyAt-game.elapsed));
  el("nitroBtn").disabled=Boolean(!game.engineOn||game.fuel<=0||game.gear!=="D"||game.active||game.ended||recharge);
  el("ignition").disabled=game.engineOn||game.ended;
  el("ignitionText").textContent=game.engineOn?"المحرك شغّال":"بصمة التشغيل";
  const nitroStatus=game.active?"نشط · "+Math.ceil(game.active)+" ث":recharge&&!game.ended?"إعادة الشحن · "+recharge+" ث":"";
  if(el("nitroStatus").textContent!==nitroStatus)el("nitroStatus").textContent=nitroStatus;
  el("rush").hidden=!game.active;
  const current=stationAt(game.km,185);
  const refueling=canRefuel(game);
  const walking=Boolean(game.pedestrian), nearDoor=walking&&distanceFromDoor()<=8;
  el("walk").textContent=walking?"اركب":"انزل";
  el("walk").disabled=walking?!nearDoor:game.speed>=1;
  el("notice").hidden=!current&&!game.ended&&!walking&&!towService&&game.fuel>0;
  el("tow").hidden=Boolean(towService||game.ended||walking||refueling||game.fuel>0||game.speed>=1);
  el("refuel").hidden=!refueling;
  el("refuel").disabled=game.fuel>=99.9;
  if(towService)el("noticeText").textContent=towService.filled?"تمت التعبئة · تكفي إلى "+towService.destination:
    towService.age<3.8?"السطحة في الطريق":"وصلت السطحة · جاري تعبئة الوقود";
  else if(walking)el("noticeText").textContent=nearDoor?"قريب من باب الحافلة · F للركوب":"ارجع إلى باب الحافلة للركوب";
  else if(refueling)el("noticeText").textContent=current.name+" · "+(game.fuel>=99.9?"الخزان ممتلئ":"جاهز للتعبئة");
  else if(game.ended)el("noticeText").textContent="وصلت إلى الطائف";
  else if(game.fuel<=0)el("noticeText").textContent="نفد الوقود";
  else if(current)el("noticeText").textContent=current.name+" · ادخل من اليمين وتوقّف بين المضخات";
}
const keymap={ArrowUp:"up",w:"up",ArrowDown:"down",s:"down",ArrowLeft:"left",a:"left",ArrowRight:"right",d:"right",q:"lookLeft",e:"lookRight",h:"horn"};
function keyFor(event){return keymap[event.key]||keymap[event.key.toLowerCase()];}
function bindWalkStick(id) {
  const stick=el(id), input={x:0,y:0};
  let pointer=null;
  const reset=()=>{
    pointer=null;input.x=0;input.y=0;
    stick.style.removeProperty("--dx");stick.style.removeProperty("--dy");
  };
  const sample=event=>{
    const rect=stick.getBoundingClientRect(), radius=Math.min(rect.width,rect.height)*.31;
    const x=(event.clientX-rect.left-rect.width*.5)/radius;
    const y=(event.clientY-rect.top-rect.height*.5)/radius;
    const norm=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(x,y));
    input.x=x/norm;input.y=y/norm;
    stick.style.setProperty("--dx",input.x*radius+"px");
    stick.style.setProperty("--dy",input.y*radius+"px");
  };
  stick.addEventListener("pointerdown",event=>{
    if(!game.pedestrian||pointer!==null||event.button!==0)return;
    event.preventDefault();stick.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    pointer=event.pointerId;sample(event);
  });
  stick.addEventListener("pointermove",event=>{if(event.pointerId===pointer)sample(event);});
  for(const type of ["pointerup","pointercancel","lostpointercapture"])
    stick.addEventListener(type,event=>{if(event.pointerId===pointer)reset();});
  return Object.assign(input,{reset});
}
const walkMove=bindWalkStick("moveStick"),walkLook=bindWalkStick("lookStick");
function clearKeys(){
  keys.clear();
  walkMove.reset();walkLook.reset();
  wheelInput=0;wheelPointer=null;
  for(const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-key]"))button.classList.remove("active");
}
const gearButtons=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-gear]"));
for(const button of gearButtons)button.onclick=()=>selectGear(button.dataset.gear);
const wheelControl=el("steering");
function wheelAngle(event){
  const bounds=wheelControl.getBoundingClientRect();
  return Math.atan2(event.clientY-bounds.top-bounds.height/2,event.clientX-bounds.left-bounds.width/2);
}
wheelControl.addEventListener("pointerdown",event=>{
  if(event.target.closest("button")||wheelPointer!==null)return;
  event.preventDefault();
  wheelControl.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  wheelPointer=event.pointerId;wheelLastAngle=wheelAngle(event);
});
wheelControl.addEventListener("pointermove",event=>{
  if(event.pointerId!==wheelPointer)return;
  const angle=wheelAngle(event),delta=angle-wheelLastAngle;
  wheelInput=clamp(wheelInput+Math.atan2(Math.sin(delta),Math.cos(delta))/.96,-1,1);
  wheelLastAngle=angle;
});
for(const type of ["pointerup","pointercancel","lostpointercapture"]){
  wheelControl.addEventListener(type,event=>{
    if(event.pointerId!==wheelPointer)return;
    wheelPointer=null;wheelInput=0;
  });
}
window.addEventListener("keydown", event=>{
  if(!game.started||document.querySelector("dialog[open]")||["INPUT","SELECT"].includes(event.target.tagName))return;
  if(event.code==="KeyF"){
    event.preventDefault();
    if(!event.repeat)toggleWalk();
    return;
  }
  if(event.code==="KeyC"&&event.target!==el("camera")){
    event.preventDefault();
    if(!event.repeat)toggleCamera();
    return;
  }
  const key=keyFor(event);if(!key)return;
  event.preventDefault();keys.add(key);if(key==="horn"&&!event.repeat)horn();
  if(key==="up")playTripPrayer();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup",event=>keys.delete(keyFor(event)));
window.addEventListener("blur",clearKeys);
for(const button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-key]")){
  const key=button.dataset.key;
  button.addEventListener("pointerdown",event=>{
    event.preventDefault();button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    keys.add(key);button.classList.add("active");if(key==="horn")horn();
    if(key==="up")playTripPrayer();
  });
  for(const type of ["pointerup","pointercancel","lostpointercapture"])button.addEventListener(type,()=>{
    keys.delete(key);button.classList.remove("active");
  });
  button.addEventListener("click",event=>{if(event.detail===0&&key==="horn")horn();});
}
el("start").onclick=()=>{
  game.started=true;el("intro").hidden=true;el("game").hidden=false;hud();
};
el("ignition").onclick=()=>{
  if(!game.started||game.engineOn||game.ended)return;
  game.engineOn=true;startAudio();hud();
};
el("help").onclick=()=>{clearKeys();el("helpDialog").showModal();};
el("tracks").onclick=()=>{clearKeys();el("trackDialog").showModal();};
el("refuel").onclick=refuel;
el("tow").onclick=requestTow;
el("nitroBtn").onclick=activate;
el("camera").onclick=toggleCamera;
el("walk").onclick=toggleWalk;
el("prev").onclick=()=>skipTrack(-1);
el("next").onclick=()=>skipTrack(1);
el("play").onclick=()=>{
  if(!tracks[trackIndex]){clearKeys();el("trackDialog").showModal();return;}
  if(audio.paused)selectTrack(trackIndex,true);else audio.pause();
};
el("volume").oninput=()=>{
  audio.volume=Number(el("volume").value);
  tripPrayer.volume=audio.volume;
  if(sfx)sfx.gain.value=audio.volume;
};
audio.volume=tripPrayer.volume=.5;
for(const type of ["play","pause","ended"])audio.addEventListener(type,mediaState);
for(const input of document.querySelectorAll("[data-track]"))input.onchange=()=>{
  const file=input.files[0];if(!file)return;
  const index=Number(input.dataset.track);
  if(tracks[index]?.url.startsWith("blob:"))URL.revokeObjectURL(tracks[index].url);
  tracks[index]={name:file.name,url:URL.createObjectURL(file)};
  if(index===trackIndex)selectTrack(index,false);
};
let last=0,lastHud=0,fpsStart=0,frames=0,deadline=0,previousRate=0;
function frame(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const rate=Number(el("rate").value),interval=1000/rate;
  if(rate!==previousRate){deadline=now;previousRate=rate;}
  if(now+.45<deadline)return;
  deadline=Math.max(now,deadline)+interval-Math.min(interval,Math.max(0,now-deadline));
  const dt=last?Math.min(.24,(now-last)/1000):0;
  last=now;
  if(dt&&!document.querySelector("dialog[open]")){
    const steps=Math.ceil(dt*120);
    for(let i=0;i<steps;i++)update(dt/steps);
  }
  render();
  if(game.started)el("steeringFace").style.rotate=(game.steer*55)+"deg";
  if(now-lastHud>=90){hud();lastHud=now;}
  frames++;
  if(now-fpsStart>=1000){
    const measured=frames*1000/(now-fpsStart);
    el("fps").textContent=" · "+Math.round(measured)+" FPS";
    if(game.started&&fpsStart){
      if(measured<Math.min(rate,60)*.8)renderScale=Math.max(.55,renderScale-.12);
      else if(measured>Math.min(rate,60)*.97)renderScale=Math.min(1,renderScale+.025);
    }
    fpsStart=now;frames=0;
  }
}
mediaState();
try{initRenderer();requestAnimationFrame(frame);}
catch(error){el("error").textContent=error.message;el("start").disabled=true;}
</script>
